what: membership inference against the training procedure, over shadow models
data: MedMNIST v2 BreastMNIST at 28 px, train and test splits (CC BY 4.0 as MedMNIST states it; the BUSI authors publish no licence; DATA_LICENSES.md); the val split selects every model's epoch, as in training
label: the true label, for all three models

models.teacher: medical_fl.resnet18's recipe, retrained on each shadow's members (random init, 60 epochs at most, AUC selection on val)
models.student: medical_fl.student's recipe, distilled from that shadow's teacher, the net-benefit cut folded into the head
models.square_student: medical_fl.square_student's recipe, distilled from that shadow's teacher

design.membership: complementary pairs: each record a member of exactly half the models

attacks.lira_online: Carlini et al., IEEE S&P 2022 (arXiv:2112.03570); implemented here
attacks.rmia_offline: Zarifzadeh, Liu and Shokri, ICML 2024 (arXiv:2312.03262); implemented here and checked against ML Privacy Meter's run_rmia at e384af8fd931

not_resolvable: fpr 0.001: 0.0052 of non-members tie at the top score
fpr 0.001: 0.0083 of non-members tie at the top score
fpr 0.001: 0.0095 of non-members tie at the top score

reading: TPR at a fixed low FPR is the measure; an AUC near 0.5 with TPR near the FPR means the attack learns little about membership from this model's outputs. An attack gives a lower bound on leakage, not a proof of its absence.
